acceptance.given: A validator or test invocation is being defined or executed from the repository root.

oracle.expected: The invocation is represented as a literal argv array and its caller supplies a finite positive timeout.
forbidden: A shell string is used as the machine command contract.
No finite positive timeout is supplied.
oracle.observable: The invocation definition and caller timeout are inspectable.

acceptance.then: The machine invocation contract contains argv elements and a finite positive caller-assigned timeout.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A targeted test raises AssertionError when the command is a shell string or timeout is absent or non-positive.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate literal argv invocation contracts with finite positive caller-assigned timeouts.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema migration.

slice_hint.state_transition: Invocation definitions become validated argv plus positive timeout.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selector rejects shell-string commands and non-positive or missing timeouts.

acceptance.given: The public validator CLI invocation is documented for repository users.

oracle.expected: Documentation names python as the active interpreter and py -3 -B as the Windows equivalent.
forbidden: The stated Windows form is omitted or excluded.
oracle.observable: Published invocation guidance is readable in the standard documentation.

acceptance.then: Documentation contains both interpreter forms with the required -B option.
acceptance.when: When documenting or reviewing the public CLI invocation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A documentation assertion raises AssertionError unless it names python as active and py -3 -B as the Windows option.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Document active interpreter and Windows invocation equivalent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation-only; no runtime or schema impact.

slice_hint.state_transition: Interpreter guidance becomes explicit and cross-platform.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The documentation check finds both exact interpreter forms.

acceptance.given: The standard ADR is in draft and may be cited by implementation or documentation.

oracle.expected: The ADR remains Proposed while drafting, and citation as new implementation authority is permitted only after normal maintainer acceptance.
forbidden: A draft ADR is cited as accepted authority.
A draft ADR is marked Accepted solely to satisfy a test.
oracle.observable: ADR status and authority citations are inspectable.

acceptance.then: Lifecycle validation confirms status gating before authority citation.
acceptance.when: During ADR review and implementation-authority citation checks.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A governance test raises AssertionError when authority is cited before maintainer acceptance or status is changed only to satisfy the test.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce Proposed-to-Accepted lifecycle gating for new ADR authority.
slice_hint.state_transition: ADR authority becomes citeable only after maintainer acceptance.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The assertion rejects premature citations and test-driven status changes.

acceptance.given: Package A scope and deliverables are being designed or implemented.

oracle.expected: Package A artifacts contain none of the explicitly excluded capabilities, systems, analyses, installation behaviors, or mandatory review requirements.
forbidden: OIDC, a total-entry Skill, physical user deletion, user-installed MCP, platform telemetry, a new error ledger, a second validation evidence system, Godot runtime analysis, package installation, or mandatory internal review is added.
oracle.observable: Scope inspection compares Package A artifacts with the frozen exclusion list.

acceptance.then: Scope validation confirms every named exclusion is absent.
acceptance.when: During Package A design, implementation, and terminal scope validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A scope-boundary test raises AssertionError when any named excluded addition appears in Package A artifacts.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Keep Package A implementation within the frozen negative scope boundary.
slice_hint.state_transition: Package A scope remains bounded by explicit exclusions.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The terminal scope assertion finds no excluded capability or system.
